option_relations.rationale: Lennox-Gastaut syndrome is a specific epileptic encephalopathy, but the genetic findings point to a more precise diagnosis related to CHD2.
Epileptic encephalopathy, early infantile type is a broad category that encompasses specific genetic forms like CHD2-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy.

Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy-94 (DEE-94) caused by pathogenic CHD2 gene variant is a direct and specific description of the condition represented by the leaf 'CHD2-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy'.
CHD2-related neurodevelopmental disorder (CHD2 encephalopathy) is an equivalent term for CHD2-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, referring to the same genetic condition.
